test: [INV-SCH-07] falsifier: the item reported at 09:00 that came back the same afternoon
what: An item is reported at 09:00 as wrong or unnatural. The catalogue's failure is FSRS re-serving it at 14:00 and again in a Mistakes session at 20:00, and the second failure is the dismissal reading as a lapse because the item accrued a week of overdue-ness while it was out of circulation.
measured: 2026-09-11, America/Los_Angeles, reported 2026-03-05T17:00:00Z (09:00 local). The window runs 158 hours, not 168: seven local days is civil-date arithmetic and 2026-03-08 is the 23-hour spring-forward day. Generation returns zero rows at every probe inside it. Overdue-ness at the moment the window closes equals overdue-ness at the moment of the report, exactly. Dismissal at +30h closes the window early with the same result.
